jobs.title: Werkstudent HR (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Die Daikin Refrigerants Frankfurt GmbH mit Sitz in Frankfurt am Main ist eine 100 %ige Tochter der Daikin Chemical Europe GmbH und damit der Daikin Industries Ltd., mit Sitz in Osaka Japan, zugehörig. Die Daikin Gruppe mit weltweit über 100.000 Mitarbeitern ist ein führender Hersteller von Klima- und Kühlgeräten sowie von fluorhaltigen Chemikalien. Neben einer Anlage zur Feindestillation des Pharma-Treibmittels S227 Pharma, welches weltweit in Dosier-Aerosolen für die Verabreichung medizinischer Wirkstoffe (e.g. Sprays gegen Asthma und COPD) eingesetzt wird, betreibt Daikin seit 2020 auch eine Aufbereitungsanlage zur Reinigung rückgewonnener fluorierter technischer Gase (HFKW), so dass diese anschließend erneut zum Einsatz in Klima- und Kühlgeräten eingesetzt werden können. Zudem verfügt der Standort über eine thermische Spaltanlage zur schadlosen Entsorgung von FCKW, HFKW und FKW. Mittels Wasserstoff-Sauerstoffflamme werden die Gase in Spaltreaktoren zu Fluss- und Salzsäure umgewandelt und als Rohstoffe wieder in den Wertstoffkreislauf zurückgeführt. Aufgaben Projektmanagement: Übernahme von spannenden HR-Projekten (bspw. Implementierung Mitarbeiter Jahresgespräche, etc.). Personalentwicklung Mitarbeit bei der Konzeption, Optimierung und Weiterentwicklung von Personalentwicklungsmaßnahmen und -prozessen. Prozessdokumentation & Compliance: Unterstützung bei der schriftlichen Ausarbeitung und Optimierung von HR-Prozessen um Richtlinien und Vorgaben zu dokumentieren. Support im Tagesgeschäft : Unterstützung des HR-Teams im operativen Alltag (bei Bedarf z. B. Unterstützung bei der Bewerberkorrespondenz). Qualifikation Hohes Sicherheitsbewusstsein und sicheres Vorgehen bei der Ausführung der Tätigkeit Eingeschrieben in einem Bachelor- oder Masterstudiengang, vorzugsweise mit Schwerpunkt Betriebswirtschaft, Personal, Arbeitsrecht oder ähnliches Selbstständige Arbeitsweise, prozessorientiertes Denken und Handeln und eine sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeit Gute MS-Office Ke

jobs.title: (Senior) Recruiter - Growing Impact Scale Up
jobs.description: Join us in Revolutionizing Supply Chains We’re a fast-growing SaaS scale-up on a mission to shape a sustainable future for the food industry. With four years of continuous 100% year-on-year growth, our team is expanding quickly. We’re looking for a proactive, highly organised Recruiter to help us find the people who will drive that growth, and to help shape how we work as we scale. Join us and shape the future of food sustainability with us! About Simvia Ensuring responsible supply chains is one of the largest challenges of our time. At Simvia we are on a path to enable the food and consumer goods industry to become a force for good, by making it simple to prove that what we eat and use is safe, compliant, and sustainable. Several of Europe's largest retailers, from Albert Heijn to Edeka, have joined Simvia together with their suppliers, and our network now spans more than 200,000 suppliers in 130 countries. AI gives us a strong tailwind: our network holds unique data, and much of the manual work in compliance can now be automated. We are growing rapidly and keep scaling with a driven, international team of 75+ people in the heart of Amsterdam. About this role You will be our first in-house Recruiter. There is no recruitment playbook yet, so you build it: the process, the guardrails and the habits that let us hire fast and well as we scale. That calls for someone who thinks "I'll find a way" rather than "what's the rule here?" Sourcing is the heart of the job. Most of your impact comes from finding and convincing great people who were not looking. Every person you bring in shapes the company we become, so we want someone who lives our culture, not only someone who can describe it. Who thrives here Our culture is driven and kind, and it only works if you bring both. Driven by the mission. You set ambitious goals, own the outcome, and welcome a high bar. Frank. You say what you think and would rather hear the truth than a comfortable story. Open. You ask for feedback

jobs.title: Senior HR Business Partner
jobs.description: About Zip Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before. The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA. Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups. Your Role You are the trusted advisor and right hand to EMEA's senior leaders, and the HRBP point of contact for the whole region. You own the full People partnership across EMEA, from our London HQ to our emerging markets. You operate as a business leader in your own right. You know how go-to-market works, from pipeline, quota, and capacity to how our customer teams deliver, and your People decisions are grounded in Zip's commercial priorities and where the region is headed. You are AI-forward and you look around corners. You use AI to be more effective in your own role and to deliver value to the business, and you spot workforce, organizational, and risk issues early and arrive with a plan. Where no framework exists for a market, a team, or a situation, you define one. You are the go-to People expert for the region, from employee relations to hiring and scaling teams, and set the standard others follow. jobs.title: Lead Recruiter (Corporate Functions)
jobs.description: About BJAK The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name. Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia. Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you. The Role We are looking for a Lead Recruiter (Corporate Functions) to lead hiring across Operations, Finance, Marketing, Creative, HR, Legal, Strategy, CEO Office, and other corporate functions globally. This role combines hands-on recruitment execution with leadership responsibilities. You will partner closely with business leaders to attract high-impact talent, drive hiring strategy, and help build a scalable Talent Acquisition function capable of supporting BJAK’s rapid global growth. You will play a critical role in shaping the organization by hiring exceptional talent while mentoring junior recruiters and establishing recruiting best practices across the business.
